Irshad on Instagram: "Jaskirat Singh Rangi (also spelled Jaskerat Singh Dangi in some references) is a fictional character from the Bollywood spy thriller Dhurandhar, portrayed by Ranveer Singh, with his backstory expanding in Dhurandhar 2 set for release on March 19, 2026.  He’s depicted as a former army captain turned elite operative, driven by family tragedy and revenge against Pakistan’s ISI-linked threats.

🌟 In the shadows of Naushera’s ambush, where bullets whispered fate, Captain Jaskirat Singh Rangi rose from the ashes of loss—a dhurandhar soul forged in fire. From prisoner’s chains to Pakistan’s jungles, his heart beats with hौसला (courage), ईंधन (fuel of vengeance), and बदला (revenge unyielding). Not just a soldier, but a storm in human form, ruling the darkness he once feared. Salute to the legend who turned pain into power! 🇮🇳⚔️ 

Hyper realistic Artwork for @ranveersingh 🔥🔥

#pencilcolor #pencilonpaper #pencilandpaper #dhurandhar #dhurandhartherevenge"
